name: Foods of Tamil Nadu — Validate on Save
description: Runs the Vitest test suite and Vite production build whenever a source file in the foods-of-tamil-nadu project is saved. Catches test failures and build errors immediately after edits.

then.command: cd my-first-kiro/foods-of-tamil-nadu && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose 2>&1 && npx vite build 2>&1
